item.title: The Yuri Doctor
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sun Kissed Games
  • 発売日: 2019-10-22
  • スコア: 5.45/10 (30 人評価)
  • 日本語名: The Yuri Doctor
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

As the owner of a private clinic Alison doesn’t have a lot of time to socialise. She puts her heart and soul into her work, but that doesn’t leave a lot of room for love.

Until a beautiful pregnant lady shows up as Alison’s newest and most interesting patient that is. Elisa immediately takes Alison’s breath away, even if they’ll never be able to be together.

item.title: The Yuri Club
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sun Kissed Games
  • 発売日: 2019-05-29
  • スコア: 6.1/10 (11 人評価)
  • 日本語名: The Yuri Club
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

Janieve High is your average all-girl high school. The only thing that makes it stand out is that it is the first school in the country to try out the bridge year initiative. Claudia Flaurance, great-granddaughter of the school’s founder, takes this opportunity to be part of the first wave of students for this optional seventh year of high school. Now that she finds herself alone and without friends in a class full of girls who have known each other for years, her new life at her ancestral school can begin.
